name: Knott's Fireman's Brigade BBQ Sliced Smoked Tri-Tip Sirloin & Baked Potato
brandOrRestaurant: Fireman's Brigade BBQ (Ghost Town · Knott's Berry Farm)
whyItWorks: Tri-tip is a lean bottom-sirloin cut; grilled over the open pit and sliced thin alongside a baked Idaho potato, it is a high-protein, dairy-free meal in Ghost Town.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Sliced Tri-Tip with a Baked Potato (swap out baked beans or corn on the cob), ask for BBQ sauce on the side, and trim off any heavily peppered outer bark edges.
watchOuts: Trim any coarse black-pepper outer crust and chew thoroughly
